notes.title: Official Release Announcement (v1.0.0)
notes.content:
Rocket Squad: Infinity has officially left Early Access.
After weeks of feedback, fixes, and balance tweaks, we are releasing version 1.0.0 as the final update for the game.
While there are still parts we wish we could have taken further, we believe this version delivers the core experience we set out to create, and deserves a proper release.

Patch Notes – v1.0.0
Added Ping System in Drone Mode
Increased enemy spawn rate at low Wanted Levels
Decreased enemy spawn rate at high Wanted Levels
Reduced difficulty gap between indoor and outdoor areas
Fixed bug: dropped currency not shown in post-death report
Fixed bug: mismatch between displayed and actual currency in report
Rebalanced artifact stats by tier

We’d like to sincerely thank everyone who played, supported, or even just gave us a shot.
Rocket Squad: Infinity may not have taken off as planned, but we’re grateful for the experience and everything we learned through its development.

This marks the end of updates for Rocket Squad: Infinity.
Our team is already working on our next game, and we hope to see you there.

Thank you.
— The Rocket Squad Team

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Content Update – April 24

This update restores multiplayer functionality and brings major improvements to stage progression, artifact balance, and various in-game systems. Thanks again for your continued feedback and support.

Multiplayer
Multiplayer functionality has been restored
→ We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Planet Missions
Each planet now features 10 distinct stages with tailored difficulty scaling
Planet unlock conditions have been adjusted for smoother progression
Mission difficulty and reward scaling systems have been rebalanced
Charge rate no longer increases by stage
Bonus rewards based on mission difficulty have been removed
Added mission clear records and stage completion rates per planet

Artifacts	
Stat values and prices for artifacts have been rebalanced
Combat power indicators have been removed from artifact items

Characters
Agents now drop all gems and credits upon death
Loan limits have been increased for Iron-ranked players

Bug Fixes & Improvements
Voice line volume reduced
Fixed animations for explosive and gas grenades
Resolved issue where heartbeat sound wouldn’t stop at low health
Updated character description for Frontrunner
Missing translations applied in loading screens
Fixed visibility issues with thrown items
Fixed emote-related item disappearance in client-to-client cases

notes.title: v0.1.1 Update
notes.content:
This update includes important improvements to single-player features, event safety, and difficulty balance. Thanks again for your continued support!

New Features
Added single-player resurrection option
→ Resurrection consumes credits, as with multiplayer

Balance Adjustments
Increased difficulty for 1- and 2-player games

Increased damage dealt by medium and small monsters

Fixes & Improvements
Gun sound adjustments

Event safety improved for dungeon risk control

Fixed missing pickup log when starting without switching characters

Removed Features
Removed public multiplayer lobbies
→ Only friend-only multiplayer is now supported

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Bug Fix

If you're still getting wrecked out there, don't worry—more tuning is on the way.

notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
We've applied a small balance patch to improve overall survivability and combat flow.	
Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming!	
	
Balance Changes	
- Medium-sized creature attack damage slightly reduced	
- Base health regeneration for all agents has been doubled	
	

If you're still getting wrecked out there, don't worry—more tuning is on the way.	
Stay safe, agents!

notes.title: First Hotfix is Live – Thanks for the Feedback!
notes.content:
First Hotfix	
	
Thanks for playing our Early Access build!	
This hotfix includes key balance adjustments and bug fixes based on early feedback.	
	
1. Balance Changes	
	
- Contract fee increased to 200 credits	
	
- Hazard pay doubled	
	
- Credit drop rate from creatures increased by 1.5x	
	
- Multiplier adjustment for 1- and 2-player teams is now easier to configure	
	
2. New Features	
	
- Added a confirmation popup when purchasing an artifact	
	
3. Bug Fixes	
	
- Fixed an issue where the Pickup section in the result screen would not appear if the game was started without switching characters
